              _ => return Err(malformed_argument(\"get-by-name\", argument)),\n            },\n            \"remove-name\" => Self::RemoveName(parse_number(argument)?),\n            _ => return &self,\n        storage: &mut S,\n    ) -> anyhow::Result<LinoDocument> {\n        Ok(match self {\n            Self::Count(restriction) => {\n                let count = matching(storage, restriction).len();\n                vec![named(\"count\", vec![LiNo::Ref(count.to_string())])]\n            }\n            Self::Each(restriction) => matching(storage, restriction)\n                .iter()\n                .map(link_lino)\n                .collect(),\n            Self::Create { source, target } => {\n                // `create` makes exactly `(index: source target)`.\n                let created = Link::new(storage.try_create(*source, *target)?, *source, *target);\n                storage.save()?;\n                changes_document(&[(Link::null(), created)])\n            }\n            Self::Update {\n                index,\n                source,\n                target,\n            } => {\n                let mut changes = Vec::new();\n                storage.update_observed(*index, *source, *target, &mut |before, after| {\n                    changes.push((before, after))\n                })?;\n                storage.save()?;\n .delete_observed(*index, &mut |before, after| changes.push((before, after)))?;\n                storage.save()?;\n                changes_document(&simplify_changes(changes))\n            }\n            Self::GetName(index) => match storage.get_name(*index)? {\n                Some(name) => vec![named(\"name\", vec![LiNo::Ref(name)])],\n                None => Vec::new(),\n            },\n            Self::SetName(index, name) => {\n                let link = storage.set_name(*index, name)?;\n                storage.save()?;\n                link_reply(Some(link))\n            }\n            Self::GetByName(name) => link_reply(storage.get_by_name(name)?),\n            Self::RemoveName(index) => {\n                storage.remove_name(*index)?;\n                storage.save()?;\n                Vec::new()\n            }\n        })\n    }\n}\n\n/// Whether `link` matches `restriction`, with the shapes of the raw links\n/// interface: see the [module documentation](self).\npub fn matches(link: &Link, restriction: &[Part]) -> bool {\n    let is = |part: Part, value: u32| part.is_none_or(|part| part == value);\n    match *restriction {\n        [] => true,\n        [index] => is(index, link.index),\n        [index, value] => {\n            is(index, link.index) && (is(value, link.source) || is(value, link.target))\n        }\n        [index, source, target] => {\n            is(index, link.index) && is(source, link.source) && is(target, link.target)\n        }\n        _ => false,\n    }\n}\n\nfn matching<S: NamedTypeLinks + ?Sized>(storage: &mut S, restriction: &[Part]) -> Vec<Link> {\n    let mut links = match restriction.first() {\n        Some(Some(index)) => storage.get_link(*index).into_iter().collect(),\n        _ => storage.all_links(),\n    };\n    links.retain(|link| matches(link, restriction));\n    links.sort_by_key(|link| link.index);\n    links\n}\n\n/// The `count` of a `(count: N)` reply.\npub fn parse_count(document: &[LiNo<String>]) ->      _ => Err(malformed_reply(\"name\", document)),\n    }\n}\n\n/// The link of a `set-name` or `get-by-name` reply.\npub fn parse_link_reply(document: &[LiNo<String>]) -> ProtocolResult<Option<u32>>      .collect(),\n    )\n}\n\nfn parse_restriction(argument: &LiNo<String>) -> ProtocolResult<Vec<Part>> {\n    let parts = parts(argument);\n    if parts.len() > 3 {\n        return LiNo substitution operations over TCP/IP (issue #105).\n//!\n//! Two interchangeable protocols carry LiNo documents between a client and a\n//! server:\n//!\n//! - [`TextLinoProtocol`]: UTF-8 LiNo text, each message ended by a line\n//!   holding only `.` (SMTP-style dot-stuffing keeps the framing unambiguous).\n//! - [`BinaryLinoProtocol`]: a self-delimiting [`LinksPacket`] of binary links\n//!   notation, made of\n//!   sections of links that share one reference width (1, 2, 4 or 8 bytes)\n//!   and one [arity range](ArityRange). By default every link is a doublet\n//!   and the whole packet uses the narrowest width that fits; the options\n//!   [external references](BinaryLinoOptions::external_references),\n//!   [arity](BinaryLinoOptions::arity) (for example `2..3` or `1..`) and\n//!   [packed widths](BinaryLinoOptions::packed_widths) can be switched on\n//!   one by one.\n//!\n//! The binary links notation itself (packets, the LiNo mapping, the canonical\n//! text form) comes from [`links_notation::binary`]; this module re-exports\n//! it and adds the transport: message framing, the server, the client and the\n//! store archive.\n//!\n//! Both implement [`LinoProtocol`], so a [`LinoConnection`] or a\n//! [`LinksClient`] switches protocol by swapping one value. A\n//! [`LinksServer`] detects the protocol of every message and answers in kind.\n//!\n//! A request is a substitution query, so it covers create, read, update and\n//! delete; the reply lists the `(before) (after)` changes, exactly like\n//! `clink --changes`. The empty request reads the whole store.\n//!\n//! ```\n//! use link_cli::protocol::{format_document, parse_document, BinaryLinoOptions, BinaryLinoProtocol};\n//!\n//! let document = parse_document(\"() ((1 1))\").unwrap();\n//! let binary = BinaryLinoProtocol::with_options(\n//!     BinaryLinoOptions::default().with_external_references(true),\n//! );\n//! let bytes = binary.encode(&document).unwrap();\n//! assert_eq!(binary.decode(&bytes).unwrap(), document);\n//! assert_eq!(format_document(&document), \"() ((1 1))\");\n//! ```\n\npub mod archive;\nmod client;\nmod error;\npub mod links_operations;\nmod protocols;\nmod remote_links;\nmod server;\n\npub use archive::{export_store, export_store_file, import_store, import_store_file};\npub use client::LinksClient;\npub use error::{ProtocolError, ProtocolResult};\npub use links_notation::binary::packet;\npub use links_notation::binary::{\n    decode_document, encode_document, encode_document_with_limits, format_document, format_link,\n    format_reference, parse_document, ArityRange, BinaryError, BinaryLinoOptions, DecodeLimits,\n    LinksPacket, LinoDocument, Reference, Section,\n};\npub use links_operations::LinksOperation;\npub use protocols::{\n    is_binary_start, read_any_document, BinaryLinoProtocol, LinoConnection, LinoProtocol,\n    MessageFormat, ProtocolLimits, TextLinoProtocol, DEFAULT_MAX_TEXT_BYTES,\n};\npub use remote_links::RemoteLinks;\npub use server::{\n    error_document, error_message, execute_request, AcceptedProtocols, LinksServer, ServerOptions,\n    ShutdownHandle,\n};\n//!               .protocol(options.limits)\n                    .write_document(&mut writer, &reply);\n                return Err(error);\n            }\n        };\n        let response = if        error_document(\"this server does not accept this protocol\")\n        };\n        format\n            .protocol(options.limits)\n            .write_document(&mut writer, &response)?;\n The links interface (`ILinks` in C#, [`doublets::Links`] in Rust) as LiNo\n//! documents, so a store behind a [`LinksServer`](super::LinksServer) is used\n//! exactly like a local one through [`RemoteLinks`](super::RemoteLinks).\n//!\n//! Every request is one top-level link named after the operation and holding\n//! exactly one value. The substitution query language ignores that shape (a\n//! query needs a restriction *and* a substitution), so an operation never\n//! collides with a query sent to the same server.\n//!\n//! | Request                          | Reply                                  |\n//! |----------------------------------|----------------------------------------|\n//! | `(count: (index source target))` | `(count: N)`                           |\n//! | `(each: (index source target))`  | one `(index: source target)` per match |\n//! | `(create: (source target))`      | `() ((index: source target))`          |\n//! | `(update: (index source target))`| `((index: s t)) ((index: source target))` per changed link |\n//! | `(delete: index)`                | `((index: source target)) ()` per removed link |\n//! | `(get-name: link)`               | `(name: 'text')`, or nothing           |\n//! | `(set-name: (link 'text'))`      | `(link: N)`                            |\n//! | `(get-by-name: 'text')`          | `(link: N)`, or nothing                |\n//! | `(remove-name: link)`            | nothing                                |\n//!\n//! A restriction holds up to three parts, matched like the raw links\n//! interface matches a query: none matches every link, `(index)` one link,\n//! `(index value)` links of that index whose source or target is `value`,\n//! and `(index source target)` matches part by part. `*` matches anything.\n//! Every reference in a reply is a number; failures are `(error: 'message')`.\n//!\n//! The changes of a `create`, `update` or `delete` are the net change of every\n//! link it touched, the way `clink --changes` reports a query: a cascading\n//! delete is one `((index: source target)) [2026-10-27T21:50:26.183Z] [STDERR] //! The links interface (`ILinks` in C#, [`doublets::Links`] in Rust) as LiNo
[2026-10-27T21:50:26.185Z] [STDERR] //! documents, so a store behind a [`LinksServer`](super::LinksServer) is used
[2026-10-27T21:50:26.189Z] [STDERR] //! exactly like a local one through [`RemoteLinks`](super::RemoteLinks).
[2026-10-27T21:50:26.192Z] [STDERR] //!
[2026-10-27T21:50:26.196Z] [STDERR] //! Every request is one top-level link named after the operation and holding
[2026-10-27T21:50:26.198Z] [STDERR] //! exactly one value. The substitution query language ignores that shape (a
[2026-10-27T21:50:26.200Z] [STDERR] //! query needs a restriction *and* a substitution), so an operation never
[2026-10-27T21:50:26.202Z] [STDERR] //! collides with a query sent to the same server.
[2026-10-27T21:50:26.203Z] [STDERR] //!
[2026-10-27T21:50:26.204Z] [STDERR] //! | Request                          | Reply                                  |
[2026-10-27T21:50:26.205Z] [STDERR] //! |----------------------------------|----------------------------------------|
[2026-10-27T21:50:26.207Z] [STDERR] //! | `(count: (index source target))` | `(count: N)`                           |
[2026-10-27T21:50:26.208Z] [STDERR] //! | `(each: (index source target))`  | one `(index: source target)` per match |
[2026-10-27T21:50:26.209Z] [STDERR] //! | `(create: (source target))`      | `() ((index: source target))`          |
[2026-10-27T21:50:26.212Z] [STDERR] //! | `(update: (index source target))`| `((index: s t)) ((index: source target))` per changed link |
[2026-10-27T21:50:26.214Z] [STDERR] //! | `(delete: index)`                | `((index: source target)) ()` per removed link |
[2026-10-27T21:50:26.215Z] [STDERR] //! | `(get-name: link)`               | `(name: 'text')`, or nothing           |
[2026-10-27T21:50:26.217Z] [STDERR] //! | `(set-name: (link 'text'))`      | `(link: N)`                            |
[2026-10-27T21:50:26.218Z] [STDERR] //! | `(get-by-name: 'text')`          | `(link: N)`, or nothing                |
[2026-10-27T21:50:26.219Z] [STDERR] //! | `(remove-name: link)`            | nothing                                |
[2026-10-27T21:50:26.222Z] [STDERR] //!

INamedTypesLinks<uint> links)\n        {\n            var anyOrZero = new HashSet<uint> { 0, links.Constants.Any };\n\n            var normalRestrictions = restrictions.Where(r => operations.Add((restrictionLink, substitutionLink));\n                    }\n                    else\n                    {\n                        operations.Add((restrictionLink, restrictionLink));\n                    }\n                }\n                else if (hasRestriction && !hasSubstitution)\n                {\n                    // Deletion\n substitutionLink));\n            }\n\n            return operations;\n        }\n\n        private static void ApplyAllPlannedOperations(\n            INamedTypesLinks<uint> links,\n These are the read-only helpers that\n//! decide whether a stored link satisfies a pattern; they carry no state beyond\n//! `QueryProcessor`'s tracing flag.\n\nuse anyhow::Result;\nuse super::GenericQueryProcessor;\n\nimpl<T: QueryAddress> GenericQueryProcessor<T> {\n    pub(super) fn match_pattern(\n        &self,\n        storage: &mut impl NamedTypeLinks<T>,\n        pattern: &Pattern,\n        current_solution: &HashMap<String, T>,\n    ) -> Result<Vec<HashMap<String, T>>> {\n        if pattern.is_leaf() {\n            let resolved_index =\n                self.resolve_match_id(storage, &pattern.index, current_solution)?;\n            let mut matches = Vec::new();\n            let mut bindings = 0usize;\n            let mut bytes = 0usize;\n            for link in storage\n                .all_links()\n                .into_iter()\n                .filter(|link| Self::is_any(resolved_index) || link.index == resolved_index)\n            {\n                let variable = Self::is_variable(&pattern.index) && link.index != T::from_byte(0);\n                let count = usize::from(variable);\n                let size = if variable {\n                    Self::binding_cost(&pattern.index)\n                } else {\n                    0\n                };\n                Self::check_solution_capacity(\n                    storage,\n                    matches.len() + 1,\n                    bindings.saturating_add(count),\n                    bytes.saturating_add(size),\n                )?;\n                let mut assignments = [2026-10-27T22:47:47.408Z] [STDERR] +# Standard queries over a private causal workspace
[2026-10-27T22:47:47.410Z] [STDERR] +
[2026-10-27T22:47:47.414Z] [STDERR] +The standard Rust protocol and the selected actual-WASM/JS session transport
[2026-10-27T22:47:47.415Z] [STDERR] +accept one top-level link named `query`, with exactly one reference containing
[2026-10-27T22:47:47.417Z] [STDERR] +the original query text. Construct this reference with the notation formatter;
[2026-10-27T22:47:47.419Z] [STDERR] +quotes, newlines and literal-reference envelopes inside the query remain text.
[2026-10-27T22:47:47.422Z] [STDERR] +
[2026-10-27T22:47:47.428Z] [STDERR] +```text
[2026-10-27T22:47:47.430Z] [STDERR] +(query: '() ((1: 1 1))')
[2026-10-27T22:47:47.434Z] [STDERR] +```
[2026-10-27T22:47:47.435Z] [STDERR] +
[2026-10-27T22:47:47.437Z] [STDERR] +The same canonical document can travel through the existing text or binary
[2026-10-27T22:47:47.439Z] [STDERR] +framing. The receiver parses the inner text with the ordinary query parser,
[2026-10-27T22:47:47.444Z] [STDERR] +preserving quoted/encoded names that resemble numeric addresses, `*` or `$x`.
[2026-10-27T22:47:47.450Z] [STDERR] +Malformed query envelopes reject. Empty inner text exports the named rows.
[2026-10-27T22:47:47.452Z] [STDERR] +Clients must select a peer that supports this envelope; a failed request is
[2026-10-27T22:47:47.456Z] [STDERR] +never resent as a different representation after an unknown outcome.
[2026-10-27T22:47:47.458Z] [STDERR] +
[2026-10-27T22:47:47.460Z] [STDERR] +Existing operation requests and direct query documents remain available.
[2026-10-27T22:47:47.463Z] [STDERR] +`count`, `each`, create/update/delete and name requests use the selected address
[2026-10-27T22:47:47.464Z] [STDERR] +type; operation replies carry decimal numeric references. A restriction's `*`
[2026-10-27T22:47:47.465Z] [STDERR] +is a separate optional part, so the maximum u64 identity remains addressable.
[2026-10-27T22:47:47.473Z] [STDERR] +Query/export replies substitute stored names and retain the established
[2026-10-27T22:47:47.477Z] [STDERR] +before/after change shape. Their canonical string model does not retain the
[2026-10-27T22:47:47.481Z] [STDERR] +name/address distinction for subsequent query replay.
[2026-10-27T22:47:47.485Z] [STDERR] +
[2026-10-27T22:47:47.490Z] [STDERR] +The checked workspace uses a wider internal address type, admits stored
[2026-10-27T22:47:47.495Z] [STDERR] +addresses from zero through u64::MAX, and retains a separate wildcard marker.
[2026-10-27T22:47:47.497Z] [STDERR] +Zero is a concrete source/target reference and remains bound during variable
[2026-10-27T22:47:47.503Z] [STDERR] +matching, repeated-variable equality, joins and substitution. A missing
[2026-10-27T22:47:47.508Z] [STDERR] +variable-map entry means unbound. Row identities remain nonzero; new row
[2026-10-27T22:47:47.512Z] [STDERR] +identities must lie in the caller's disjoint reservation, while known retained
[2026-10-27T22:47:47.515Z] [STDERR] +identities may be recreated. All changes stay private until explicit-token
[2026-10-27T22:47:47.517Z] [STDERR] +session publication. Query saves do not publish.
[2026-10-27T22:47:47.519Z] [STDERR] +
[2026-10-27T22:47:47.520Z] [STDERR] +The shared processor previews the query against owned rows/names and reserves
[2026-10-27T22:47:47.521Z] [STDERR] +its exact allocations before applying real edits. Checked input, matching and
[2026-10-27T22:47:47.523Z] [STDERR] +reply admission rejects unsupported requests before those edits. See
[2026-10-27T22:47:47.525Z] [STDERR] +[the session contract](../ENGINE-CAUSAL-SESSIONS.md) for exact limits, owned
[2026-10-27T22:47:47.526Z] [STDERR] +copies, preparation, retry behavior and costs. These bounds apply to checked
[2026-10-27T22:47:47.528Z] [STDERR] +sessions; the existing ordinary u32 facade retains its selected store policy.
[2026-10-27T22:47:47.529Z] [STDERR] +
[2026-10-27T22:47:47.530Z] [STDERR] +[`causal-query-v1.json`](causal-query-v1.json) specifies independent finite
[2026-10-27T22:47:47.532Z] [STDERR] +behavioral vectors. Every case supplies an inclusive fresh reservation,
[2026-10-27T22:47:47.534Z] [STDERR] +initial retained rows, original query texts with expected success/error,
[2026-10-27T22:47:47.535Z] [STDERR] +expected final private rows, the next allocated identity and the final edit
[2026-10-27T22:47:47.536Z] [STDERR] +count after creating/deleting that next identity. Addresses use canonical
[2026-10-27T22:47:47.537Z] [STDERR] +decimal strings; names are nullable strings. Cases are independent, so their
[2026-10-27T22:47:47.538Z] [STDERR] +publication tokens and reservations need not be globally unique.
[2026-10-27T22:47:47.540Z] [STDERR] +
[2026-10-27T22:47:47.541Z] [STDERR] +Native Rust, linked actual WASM and actual Node/Bun/Deno consume these vectors.

Pattern matching lives in a submodule; see query_processor/matching.rs.\nmod matching;\n// Write-side operations live in a submodule; see query_processor/mutations.rs.\nmod mutations;\n\n/// The `(before, after)` states a query reports, where `None` is no link:\n/// `(None, Some(link))` is a creation and `(Some(link), None)` a deletion.\npub type Changes<T = u32> = Vec<(Option<Link<T>>, Option<Link<T>>)>;\n\ntype ResolvedChange<T> = (Option<ResolvedLink<T>>, Option<ResolvedLink<T>>);\n\n/// The existing u32 CLI facade.\npub type QueryProcessor = GenericQueryProcessor<u32>;\n\n/// QueryProcessor handles LiNo query parsing and execution\n/// Corresponds to AdvancedMixedQueryProcessor in C#\npub struct GenericQueryProcessor<T: QueryAddress> {\n    address: std::marker::PhantomData<T>,\n    trace: bool,\n    auto_create_missing_references: bool,\n    validate_references: bool,\n}\n\nimpl<T: QueryAddress> GenericQueryProcessor<T> {\n    /// Creates a new QueryProcessor\n    pub fn new(trace: bool) -> Self {\n        Self {\n            address: std::marker::PhantomData,\n            trace,\n            auto_create_missing_references: false,\n            validate_references: true,\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub fn with_auto_create_missing_references(\n        mut self,\n        auto_create_missing_references: bool,\n    ) -> Self {\n        self.auto_create_missing_references = auto_create_missing_references;\n        self\n    }\n\n    /// Processes a LiNo query and returns the list of changes.\n    ///\n    /// Every scenario is simplified on the way out, matching the C# CLI, which\n    /// collects the raw handler calls and runs `SimplifyChanges` over them once\n    /// in `Program.cs` regardless of which branch of the processor produced\n    /// them.\n    pub fn process_query(\n        &self,\n        storage: &mut impl NamedTypeLinks<T>,\n        query: &str,\n    ) -> Result<Changes<T>> {\n        let changes = self.process_query_raw(storage, query)?;\n        Ok(self.simplify_changes_list(&changes))\n    }\n\n    /// The processor proper: applies `query` and reports the raw\n    /// `(before, after)` states, in the order they happened.\n    fn process_query_raw(\n        &self,\n        storage: &mut impl NamedTypeLinks<T>,\n        query: &str,\n    ) -> Result<Changes<T>> {\n        if storage\n            .query_limits()\n            .is_some_and(|limits| query.len() > limits.max_bytes)\n        {\n            return Err(LinkError::QueryError(\"query byte limit exceeded\".into()).into());\n        }\n        self.trace_msg(&format!(\"[ProcessQuery] Query: \\\"{}\\\"\", query));\n\n        let query = query.trim();\n        if query.is_empty() {\n            self.trace_msg(\"[ProcessQuery] Query is empty, returning.\");\n            return Ok(vec![]);\n        }\n\n        let parsed_links = crate::query_parser::parse_for::<T>(query, storage.query_limits())?;\n\n        self.trace_msg(&format!(\n            \"[ProcessQuery] Parser returned {} top-level link(s).\",\n            parsed_links.len()\n        ));\n\n        if parsed_links.is_empty() {\n            self.trace_msg(\"[ProcessQuery] No top-level parsed links found, returning.\");\n            return Ok(vec![]);\n        }\n\n        // Accept both the wrapped form `((restriction) (substitution))` and\n        // the C# parser-compatible form `restriction substitution`.\n        let (restriction_link, substitution_link) = match &parsed_links[0].values {\n            Some(values) if values.len() >= 2 => (&values[0], &values[1]),\n            _ if parsed_links.len() >= 2 => (&parsed_links[0], &parsed_links[1]),\n            _ => {\n                self.trace_msg(\"[ProcessQuery] Query has fewer than 2 links, returning.\");\n                return Ok(vec![]);\n            }\n        };\n\n        self.process_lino_raw(storage, restriction_link, substitution_link)\n    }\n\n    /// Reuse the complete execution path on an owned scratch store. Only the\n    /// reference-validation recursion is disabled; matching and allocation are\n    /// exactly the operations the real session will execute.\n    pub(crate) fn preview(\n        &self,\n        storage: &mut impl NamedTypeLinks<T>,\n        restriction_link: &LinoLink,\n        substitution_link: &LinoLink,\n    ) -> Result<()> {\n        let preview = Self {\n            address: std::marker::PhantomData,\n            trace: self.trace,\n            auto_create_missing_references: self.auto_create_missing_references,\n            validate_references: false,\n        };\n        let changes = preview.process_lino_raw(storage, restriction_link, substitution_link)?;\n        if storage.query_limits().is_some() {\n            // The protocol names references from the final staged state. Check\n            // that same output while only owned preview rows have changed.\n            let mut budget =\n                crate::query_reply_budget::QueryReplyBudget::new(storage.query_limits());\n            for (before, after) in preview.simplify_changes_list(&changes) {\n                for link in [before, after].into_iter().flatten() {\n                    for id in [link.index, link.source, link.target] {\n                        budget.reference(storage, id)?;\n                    }\n Trace { get; init; }\n}\npublic sealed record CausalPreparedBatch(string Token, ulong Generation, IReadOnlyList<CausalBatchEdit> Edits);\n\n/// <summary>A frozen causal snapshot, standard private links session and one\n/// explicit-token local batch. Caller-reserved addresses are not a global allocator.</summary>\npublic sealed class CausalSession : INamedTypesLinks<ulong>, IDisposable\n{\n    private readonly CausalBatch _batch;\n    private readonly ulong _generation, _first, _last;\n    private BigInteger _next;\n    private LinksEngine<ulong>? _engine;\n    private EngineSession<ulong>? _inner;\n    private readonly SortedDictionary<ulong, EngineRow<ulong>> _original = new();\n    private readonly Dictionary<ulong, CausalVersion[]> _retained = new();\n    private EngineRow<ulong>[] _finalRows = [];\n    private CausalPreparedBatch? _prepared;\n    private CausalVersion[]? _result;\n    private bool _disposed;\n    public LinksConstants<ulong> Constants { get; } = new((1UL, ulong.MaxValue));\n    private static InvalidOperationException Frozen() => new(\"Invalid or frozen causal session.\");\n    private EngineSession<ulong> Active => _inner ?? options = null)\n    {\n        options ??= new();\n        if (first == 0 || first > last) throw Frozen();\n        _batch = batch; var snapshot = batch.Snapshot(); _generation = snapshot.Generation;\n        var projection = new CausalProjection(snapshot.Versions, policy, options.Projection);\n        foreach (var group in projection.Versions().GroupBy(v => v.Address))\n        {\n            if (group.Key >= first && group.Key <= last) throw Frozen();\n            _retained.Add(group.Key, group.ToArray());\n        }\n        foreach (var row in projection.Rows()) _original.Add(row.Link.Index, row);\n        _first = first; _last = last; _next = first;\n        _engine = new(new MemoryCommitLog(), new()\n        {\n            StateStructure = options.StateStructure,\n            Constraints = options.Constraints,\n            ConstraintValidation = options.ConstraintValidation,\n            Trace = options.Trace\n        });\n        _engine.Validate(_original);\n        _engine.Current = EngineSnapshot<ulong>.Create(0, new EngineRows<ulong>(_original, options.StateStructure));\n        _engine.Next = _engine.CommittedNext = _original.Count == 0 ? GetLink(ulong id) => _inner is { } tx ? tx.GetLink(id)\n        : _finalRows.Where(row => row.Link.Index == id).Select(row => (Link<ulong>?)row.Link).FirstOrDefault();\n    public Link<ulong> UpdateLink(ulong id, ulong source, ulong target) => Active.UpdateLink(id, source, target);\n    public Link<ulong> DeleteLink(ulong id) => Active.DeleteLink(id);\n    private CausalBatchEdit[] Finish()\n    {\n        var tx = Active; var engine = _engine!; _inner = null; _engine = null;\n        try\n        {\n            tx.Commit(); _finalRows = engine.Snapshot().Rows.Values.ToArray();\n            var final = _finalRows.ToDictionary(row => row.Link.Index);\n            var edits = _original.Keys.Concat(final.Keys).Distinct().Order().Where(id =>\n                !_original.TryGetValue(id, out var before) || !final.TryGetValue(id, out var after) || before != after)\n                .Select(id => new CausalBatchEdit(id, _retained.GetValueOrDefault(id) ?? [], final.TryGetValue(id, out var row)\n                    ? new(row.Link.Source, row.Link.Target, row.Name) : null)).ToArray();\n            return CausalBatch.Normalize(edits).Edits;\n        }\n        finally { tx.Dispose(); _original.Clear(); _retained.Clear(); }\n    }\n    public CausalPreparedBatch? Prepared => _prepared is { } value ?      return candidates.Where(restriction.Matches).OrderBy(link => link.Index).ToList();\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// The net change of every link a write touched: the steps a store takes to get there differ between the C# and\n    /// the Rust stores, the net changes do not.\n    /// </summary>\n    private static IReadOnlyList<LinoLink> NetChangesDocument(List<(DoubletLink Before, DoubletLink After)> steps) =>\n        ChangesDocument(ChangesSimplifier.SimplifyChanges(steps));\n\n    /// <summary>Runs <paramref name=\"write\"/> and returns every change it reports, in order.</summary>\n    private static List<(DoubletLink Before, DoubletLink After)> Recorded(INamedTypesLinks<uint> links, Action<WriteHandler<uint>> write)\n    {\n        var changes = new List<(DoubletLink Before, DoubletLink After)>();\n        write((before, after) =>\n        {\n            changes.Add((new DoubletLink(before), new DoubletLink(after)));\n            return links.Constants.Continue;\n        });\n        return changes;\n    }\n\n    private static void ThrowIfMissing(INamedTypesLinks<uint> links, uint index)\n    {\n        if (!links.Exists(index))\n        {\n            throw new ArgumentException($\"Link not found: {index}\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static DoubletLink ParseChangeSide(LinoLink side) => side switch\n    {\n        { Id: null, Values: [] } => default,\n        { Id: null, Values: [var link] } => ParseLink(link),\n        // `((index: source target))` loses its wrapper when the side is the single named link itself.\n        { Id: not null, Values: not null } => ParseLink(side),\n        _ => throw LinoProtocolException.Malformed($\"expected a change side, found {LinoFormat.FormatLink(side)}\"),\n    };\n\n    private static DoubletLink ParseLink(LinoLink link) => link is { Id: { } index, Values: [var source, var target] }\n        ? new DoubletLink(ParseNumber(index), ParseNumber(source), ParseNumber(target))\n        : throw LinoProtocolException.Malformed($\"expected (index: source target), found {LinoFormat.FormatLink(link)}\");\n\n    private static LinksRestriction ParseRestriction(LinoLink argument)\n    {\n        var parts = Parts(argument);\n        if (parts.Count > 3)\n        {\n            throw MalformedArgument(\"restriction\", argument);\n        }\n        return new LinksRestriction(parts\n            .Select(part => part is { Values: null, Id: LinksRestriction.AnyPart } ? null : (uint?)ParseNumber(part))\n            .ToList());\n    }\n\n    private static uint[] ParseNumbers(LinoLink argument, int count)\n    {\n        var numbers = Parts(argument).Select(ParseNumber).ToArray();\n        return numbers.Length == count ? numbers : throw MalformedArgument($\"{count} numbers\", argument);\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// The values of an unnamed group; a lone reference is a group of one, since the canonical document model\n    /// unwraps <c>(x)</c> to <c>x</c>.\n    /// </summary>\n    private static IReadOnlyList<LinoLink> Parts(LinoLink argument) =>\n        argument is { Id: null, Values: { } values } ? values.ToList() : new[] { argument };\n\n    private static uint ParseNumber(LinoLink value) => value is { Values: null, Id: { } text }\n        ? ParseNumber(text)\n        : throw LinoProtocolException.Malformed($\"expected a number, found {LinoFormat.FormatLink(value)}\");\n\n    private static uint ParseNumber(string text) =>\n        uint.TryParse(text, NumberStyles.None, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var number)\n            ? number\n            : throw LinoProtocolException.Malformed($\"expected a number, found '{text}'\");\n\n    private static LinoProtocolException MalformedArgument(string expected, LinoLink argument) =>\n        LinoProtocolException.Malformed($\"expected {expected}, found {LinoFormat.FormatLink(argument)}\");\n\n    private static LinoProtocolException MalformedReply(string expected, IReadOnlyList<LinoLink> document) =>\n        LinoProtocolException.Malformed($\"expected a {expected} reply, found {LinoFormat.FormatDocument(document)}\");\n}\nusing System.Net;\nusing System.Net.Sockets;\nusing System.Text;\nusing The steps of one address form a chain, so its net\n        /// change is the before of its first step and the after of its last:\n        /// a link created and deleted again within the query is not reported, and a link that ends\n        /// where it started is reported unchanged, like a link the query only matched.\n        /// The changes are ordered by their after state, so deletions come first; changes with equal\n        /// after states keep the order of their first step.\n        /// </remarks>\n        public static IEnumerable<(Link<uint> Before, Link<uint> After)> SimplifyChanges(\n            IEnumerable<(Link<uint> Before, Link<uint> After)> changes\n        )\n        {\n            ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(changes);\n\n            var netChanges = new List<(Link<uint> Before, Link<uint> After)>();\n            var positionOfAddress = new Dictionary<uint, int>();\n            foreach (var (before, after) in changes)\n            {\n                var address = before.Index != 0 ? before.Index : after.Index;\n                if (address == 0)\n                {\n                    continue;\n                }\n                if (positionOfAddress.TryGetValue(address, out var position))\n                {\n                    netChanges[position] = (netChanges[position].Before, after);\n                }\n                else\n                {\n                    positionOfAddress[address] = netChanges.Count;\n                    netChanges.Add((before, after));\n                }\n            }\n            return netChanges\n                .Where(change => !(IsNull(change.Before) && IsNull(change.After)))\n                .OrderBy(change => change.After.Index)\n                .ThenBy(change => change.After.Source)\n                .ThenBy(change => change.After.Target)\n                .ToList();\n        }\n\n        private static bool IsNull(Link<uint> link) => link.Index == 0 && link.Source == 0 && link.Target == 0;\n    }\n}\n","exit_code":0,"status":"completed"}}
